name: Inspo
description: Drag screenshots into a sidebar board and keep your references beside your work.

cover.alt: The Inspo panel in Orca's sidebar, showing a pinned screenshot above a two-column grid, next to the expanded viewer.

screenshots.alt: The empty Inspo panel inviting you to drop screenshots, next to the panel highlighted while three files are dragged over it.
screenshots.caption: Drag screenshots straight into the sidebar.

screenshots.alt: A pinned screenshot shown large at the top of the panel, with the rest of the screenshots in a two-column grid below.
screenshots.caption: Pin the one you're building from.

screenshots.alt: The expanded viewer showing one screenshot larger, with previous and next arrows, the file name, and pin and remove buttons.
screenshots.caption: Click any screenshot to see it larger.
